questions.q: Is this training only for people with logistics background?
questions.a: No. We've trained professionals from IT, commerce, engineering, and various backgrounds. The industry welcomes skilled people.

questions.q: Will I definitely get a job after training?
questions.a: We provide training, mentorship, and placement support. Your effort + our guidance = high chances. Not a guarantee, but we're very successful.

questions.q: How long will it take to get job-ready?
questions.a: 6-8 weeks for our core program. You'll see progress within 2 weeks.
Yes. Our programs are flexible (online, weekend batches, self-paced).
Yes. Recognised within the industry + by TIRWIN's network.

questions.q: What if I'm still unsure about logistics?
questions.a: Perfect. Attend the webinar first. Explore. Get clarity. Then decide. No pressure.
